title: Crispy Roasted Pork Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Vietnamese-inspired dish made with tender pork, crispy roasted vegetables, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat. Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and roast the pork for 20 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger, minced garlic, chopped onions, carrots, and potatoes to the pan. Toss to coat with the juices.
Continue roasting for an additional 30-40 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the pork is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
